apps.name: Tuna
apps.subtitle: Your music at home.
apps.localizedDescription: Your music from your Tuna server, with mixes and lyrics. Download songs to play offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
Fixed
- The apps used a lot of energy on playlists with songs on their way: each of those songs asked the server where it was at by itself, every five seconds, for the whole list of what's on its way (on a playlist with 77 songs waiting, over 200 requests in 15 seconds, and every one of them spinning). Now one small look every five seconds covers every song on screen, and only what's moving is sent. Songs far down a long list now update too.

Changed
- A dot instead of a spinning circle: faint and still while a song waits its turn, glowing while it's looked for (a few at a time), then a little circle that fills up as it downloads. The button lines up with the ⋯ of the songs around it.

To update: the server (pull the new image). The apps need nothing new.
